name: 360gnh-knowledge-studio
description: Provider-neutral knowledge studio for cited chat, learning artifacts, and multi-perspective debate.
author: Nguyễn Duy Hưng

scripts.build: npm run build -w @360gnh/core && npm run build -w @360gnh/api && npm run build -w @360gnh/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @360gnh/api" "npm run dev -w @360gnh/web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @360gnh/core && npm run lint -w @360gnh/api && npm run lint -w @360gnh/web
scripts.preflight: npm run check && npm run eval && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
scripts.test: npm run test -w @360gnh/core && npm run test -w @360gnh/api && npm run test -w @360gnh/web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @360gnh/core && npm run test:coverage -w @360gnh/api && npm run test:coverage -w @360gnh/web
